=== THE LIVE CRITERION IS NOW MET. THE CELL IS GREEN ON A REAL DC INSTANCE, WITH NO ASSERTION WEAKENED. ===

HARNESS RUN 30772461871, job id 91561874505, main @ bd3de0f864 — the tree containing this fix
(ff7a761267, Gerrit 1232) and its RED-first companion (c83263b7d4, Gerrit 1231). 1674.11s.
    [jira-live-canary] collected=49 executed=49 skipped=0
    1 failed, 48 passed
    PASSED tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_mutations.py::test_the_inbound_assignee_mints_a_jira_family_identity

WHY THIS GREEN CARRIES INFORMATION, which is the criterion's actual requirement:
 * The oracle is BYTE-UNCHANGED since changes 1226/1227 — this ticket touched production code only,
   never the cell. So the green cannot have come from a relaxed assertion.
 * The SAME cell, with the SAME assertions, FAILED on the immediately preceding run 30767546938
   (main @ d72c4777d3, pre-fix) with "THE PASS MINTED NOTHING: jira/'admin' still resolves to no
   identity in the store copy after an inbound pass that carried that assignee." Same harness, same
   default-configured instance, same oracle. The only variable is this fix.
 * The oracle retains every assertion it had: absent-before via read-only resolve_mapping,
   resolving-after, is_placeholder, and resolve_mapping("jira-datacenter", ...) is None so the
   provider family is asserted in BOTH directions.

So the before/after pair is controlled, and the criterion "goes green on a harness run WITHOUT any
weakening of its assertions" is satisfied in the strong sense rather than the weak one.

THE RUN'S ONE FAILURE IS NOT THIS TICKET'S: test_transport.py's rekey cell tripped its own setup
assertion because the harness drew a project key ending in "Z" and the cell derives its rename target
as (key[:-1] + "Z"), producing a collision. Flaky by construction ~1 run in 26, unrelated to the
differ or the applier, filed as [rebar:d582-fd5a-7ece-4c32].

Both close criteria are now addressed: the amended cells-2-and-4 criterion (see the description, which
records why cell 2 must NOT invert — inverting it would assert that the mint accepts a bare string, the
one fix this ticket prohibits) and this live verdict.
